title: Hit the Open Road
theme: Road trips: Route 66, Cars Land and travel films
intro: [excited] Buckle up, road trippers! Today we're hitting the OPEN ROAD: Route 66, Cars Land and every Disney movie where somebody packs a bag. [laughs] And no, we are NOT there yet.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. An empty two-lane desert highway at golden hour stretching toward red rock mountains, a vintage turquoise convertible parked by a neon-lit roadside diner, a long dusty horizon and a big orange sun.

categories.title: Goofy Road Trip
categories.intro: Our film category: A Goofy Movie, the ultimate father and son road trip! [chuckles] Gawrsh.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A cluttered old station wagon on a winding mountain highway, fishing rods and a canoe strapped to the roof, a paper road map flapping out the window, pine forests and a distant lake.

clues.clue: In A Goofy Movie, Goofy drags his teenage son on a cross-country fishing trip. Name the son.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Max! [laughs] He just wanted to impress a girl. Dad wanted to catch a fish. Classic.

clues.clue: Max tells his crush he'll be onstage with this pop star at a big concert.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Powerline! Stand Out and I 2 I are absolute bangers. Do not argue with me.

clues.clue: Goofy's plan is to fish at Lake Destiny in this state.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Idaho! [sarcastic] Every teenager's dream summer destination.

clues.clue: Max secretly changes the map route so they end up in this city for the concert.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Los Angeles! They also took a VERY unplanned rafting trip down a waterfall on the way.

clues.clue: Goofy teaches Max this secret family fishing move, which accidentally attracts Bigfoot.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Perfect Cast! [chuckles] And it comes back for the big finale onstage. Goofy wins.

categories.title: Pack Your Bags
categories.intro: Disney characters LOVE a long journey. Name where they're going, or what's taking them there. [excited] Snacks in the back!

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A pile of vintage travel trunks and suitcases on a sunlit dock beside the ocean, a sailing canoe on the water, a compass and rolled maps, distant tropical islands.

clues.clue: In Moana, Moana sails across the ocean to return the heart of this island goddess.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Te Fiti! [laughs] Plus one demigod, one rooster, and absolutely zero sailing lessons.

clues.clue: In The Rescuers Down Under, Bernard and Bianca fly an albatross airline to this country to rescue a boy.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Australia! [laughs] Their pilot, Wilbur the albatross, has the bumpiest landings in Disney history.

clues.clue: In Luca, Luca and Alberto dream of buying one of these Italian scooters and riding around the world.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a Vespa! Silenzio, Bruno! Nothing says freedom like two sea monsters on a scooter.

clues.clue: In Brother Bear, Kenai must journey to the mountain where these touch the earth.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the lights! [sighs] The northern lights, home of the spirits. Way cooler than a rest stop.

clues.clue: In Bolt, the superdog is accidentally shipped to this city, then crosses the country back to Hollywood.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is New York City! A cat, a hamster in a ball and a dog walk across America. That's not a joke... it's a road trip.

categories.title: Vanity Plates
categories.intro: It's Vanity Plates! Each clue is a custom license plate. [mischievously] Tell me which Disney character is driving.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A wall of colourful vintage license plates in a desert garage, rust, sun-faded paint and chrome, the plates blank and embossed with only abstract stars and stripes, no letters.

clues.clue: The license plate reads K A C H O W. Who's driving?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Lightning McQueen! [laughs] Although technically he IS the car, so he's also the plate.

clues.clue: The license plate reads 2 N F N T Y. Who's driving?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Buzz Lightyear! To infinity... and the nearest gas station.

clues.clue: The license plate reads J S T K P S W M. Who's driving?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dory! Just keep swimming! [chuckles] Or in this case, just keep driving... and maybe ask for directions.

clues.clue: The license plate reads B B D B O O. Who's driving?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Fairy Godmother! Her car turns back into a pumpkin at midnight, so park it early.

clues.clue: The license plate reads A N Y 1 C N C K. Whose motto is this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Auguste Gusteau! Anyone can cook. [chuckles] Anyone can also parallel park, allegedly.

categories.title: Cars Land Cruise
categories.intro: Next stop, Cars Land at Disney California Adventure! Look at the picture and name the spot. [excited] Ka-chow!

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A desert main street at dusk with glowing neon signs, red rock buttes shaped like classic car tail fins on the horizon, a giant orange traffic-cone shaped building, chrome and turquoise everywhere.

clues.clue: This Cars Land thrill ride races you side by side through red rock mountains.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Radiator Springs Racers! [excited] It hits about 40 miles per hour. Not bad for a car with eyes.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. Two convertible ride cars racing side by side on a curving road through towering red sandstone buttes under a bright blue desert sky.

clues.clue: Little Italian cars dance in circles outside a tire shop at this Cars Land ride.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Luigi's Rollickin' Roadsters! They took over from Luigi's Flying Tires in 2016. [laughs] Bellissimo.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A charming courtyard of an Italian tire shop with tall stacks of tires, green-white-red bunting, string lights, and tiny round convertibles twirling on a smooth floor.

clues.clue: At this Cars Land ride, baby tractors swing you around in a square dance.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mater's Junkyard Jamboree! Yee-haw! It's the only square dance where your partner has a tow hook.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A dusty junkyard under a corrugated tin roof full of rusty hubcaps, old signs with no lettering and fairy lights, little tractor ride vehicles whipping in loops.

clues.clue: You can grab churros and soft serve from giant orange traffic cones at this Cars Land stop.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Cozy Cone Motel! [chuckles] Snacks in a traffic cone. Somebody give that Imagineer a raise.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. Giant bright orange traffic cone shaped buildings with windows and neon trim along a desert roadside at sunset, a churro cart in front.

clues.clue: Cars Land opened at Disney California Adventure in this year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 2012! Opening day brought hours-long waits for Radiator Springs Racers. [sighs] Worth it.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A sweeping dusk view of a desert themed town lit up with neon, red rock mountains glowing pink behind it, a crowd-free main road shining after rain.

categories.title: Real Road, Reel Road
categories.intro: Our wildcard: the REAL Route 66 places that inspired Radiator Springs. [whispers] Get your kicks.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A faded old highway shield-shaped sign with no lettering beside an Art Deco gas station and a row of teepee-shaped motel rooms under a starry desert sky.

clues.clue: In Cars, Lightning McQueen's rusty tow truck best friend is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mater! Like tuh-mater, but without the tuh. [laughs] He told us himself.

clues.clue: The real Route 66 starts in this big Illinois city.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Chicago! From there it's nearly 2,500 miles to the Pacific. Pack snacks.

clues.clue: The Cozy Cone Motel was inspired by real Route 66 motels where you sleep in rooms shaped like these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is teepees! The Wigwam Motels in Arizona and California still rent them out today.

clues.clue: Cars Land's Cadillac Range honors this Texas art installation of half-buried cars near Amarillo.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Cadillac Ranch! [chuckles] Ten Cadillacs, nose down in the dirt. The ultimate parking fail.

clues.clue: Ramone's House of Body Art was inspired by this Art Deco gas station in Shamrock, Texas.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the U-Drop Inn! It's a visitor center now, and yes, it looks EXACTLY like the movie.
